spec.claim_summary: EMA 5 crossing 50EMA together with RSI 5 crossing the 50 line on bar close generates a signal.
assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim says only 'crosses' with no above/below and no long/short stated, implying potentially both directions, but schema allows only one direction and requires crosses_above or crosses_below; encoded long-side crosses_above only and the short-side mirror is omitted.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim states no exit, stop, target, or holding period; a testable spec requires an exit, so added the opposite-cross exit as the closest testable core.
Chose timeframe 1d from the two stated options 'daily and 4 hour charts' following the page chart timeframe of 1d; the 4h alternative was not tested.
RSI length is 5 from 'RSI to 5' and RSI level is 50 from '50 line'.
Required both crosses on the same bar close per 'once your 5ema crosses your 50ema and RSI cross the 50 line'.
Waiting for the candle to close corresponds to bar-close evaluation with fill at next bar open.
Treated switching to daily/4h and opening 4 trades as usage anecdote, not as an entry time filter; engine tests over all history.
Asset names converted from slash form to non-slash form without change of market; forex symbols have no bundled data and engine will report lack of data.

evidence.quote: on USD/CAD, EUR/USD, GBP/USD, and also EUR/JPY
on the daily and 4 hour charts

audit_majors: direction: Claim says '5ema crosses your 50ema and RSI cross the 50 line' with no above/below or long/short stated, implying both directions. Spec encodes long / crosses_above only and omits the short-side mirror, so only half the implied signals are tested.
